about: The researched entries of EnforcementAircraft. Additions only: an entry leaves the list only when it is found NOT to be involved, and then stays here with status cleared and the reason.

entries.name: Federal law-enforcement registrants
entries.rule: Every aircraft in the FAA Releasable Aircraft Database registered to a federal law-enforcement agency (Department of Homeland Security and its components, Customs and Border Protection, Immigration and Customs Enforcement, the Department of Justice and its components, the US Marshals Service), or to a contractor operator named in contractor_operators. A private registrant is named there only when a cited document backs it.

evidence.what: Registered to the agency, or to its named contractor operator, in the FAA aircraft registry.

entries.name: Texas Department of Public Safety, Aircraft Operations Division
owner_names: DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC SAFETY OF THE STATE OF TEXAS

evidence.what: Texas governor's Operation Lone Star release: DPS aircraft helped apprehend 15 people, all referred to Border Patrol.
A DPS helicopter flew overhead during a Liberty County Precinct 4 Constable operation with ICE; the people it spotted were caught and turned over to ICE.

entries.name: Florida Highway Patrol, Aviation
owner_names: DEPARTMENT OF HIGHWAY SAFETY AND MOTOR VEHICLES

evidence.what: At a governor's briefing, officials said an operation based at the Davie FHP station included ICE, Border Patrol and Florida Highway Patrol aviation.

entries.name: Florida State Guard, Aviation

evidence.what: The same briefing listed State Guard aviation among the participants in the operation with ICE and Border Patrol.

entries.name: Pinal County Sheriff's Office, Arizona

evidence.what: Pinal Air 1, flying under Operation Stonegarden (a DHS grant to border counties), carried Border Patrol agents who found a group of 18 people. Reporting more than five years old.

entries.name: Homeland Aviation LLC, Shreveport, Louisiana

evidence.what: Was listed as a federal contractor operator on its name alone.

cleared.why: A private LLC at a Shreveport street address that owns light piston aircraft (N462WC, a 2012 Aviat A-1C-200 Husky). USAspending.gov holds no federal contract, contract vehicle or grant to any recipient of that name (searched 2026-10-23; only SBA pandemic small-business aid), and no reporting links it to DHS or any federal agency.

entries.name: CBP Air Logistics LLC, Statham, Georgia

evidence.what: Was listed as a federal contractor operator on its name alone.

cleared.why: Not Customs and Border Protection. Its own court complaint says it is a Georgia LLC managed and wholly owned by a private individual, and the sole owner of a Citation CJ4 (N150RC).

entries.name: CBP MQ-9 CBP113 (N917JA), broadcast hex AE2FD0

evidence.what: RadioReference wiki's CBP Air and Marine table (community-edited) lists N917JA (CBP113), a General Atomics MQ-9, ICAO hex AE2FD0, at NASOC San Angelo (SJT), callsign TROY 701, last heard by ADS-B 2026-06-04.

FAA registry: N917JA is registered to the Department of Homeland Security as a General Atomics MQ-9 Block 1, under hex ACB175 (already on this list); the aircraft is reported broadcasting AE2FD0 instead.
TWZ reported a CBP MQ-9 Guardian as TROY701 out of San Angelo flying deep into Mexico, quoting a post that ties CBP-113 to hex AE2FD0.

entries.name: ICE Air charter: GlobalX Airbus A320-214 N278GX, hex A2C4E0

evidence.what: Three GlobalX aircraft, N278GX, N837VA and N630VA, moved Venezuelans held at the El Valle Detention Center on 2025-03-15.
ICE books its charter flights through the broker CSI Aviation, which hires GlobalX and Eastern Air Express for most of them.
FAA registry: N278GX is registered to UMB BANK NA TRUSTEE, a Airbus A320-214.

entries.name: Avelo Boeing 737-800 N801XT, hex AAE7B3

evidence.what: Avelo began ICE charter flights from Mesa Gateway (AZA) with three Boeing 737-800s, N801XT, N804VL and N805VL, repainted all white without Avelo's titles.
Human Rights First counted more than 1,900 ICE flights by Avelo from May to December 2025.
N801XT was the first Avelo aircraft on ICE flights, by Flightradar24 data, painted white.
FAA registry: N801XT is registered to BANK OF UTAH TRUSTEE, a Boeing 737-800.

cleared.why: Avelo closed its Mesa Gateway base on 2026-01-27 and ended its part in the DHS charter program. Flight trackers show its white 737-800s back on Avelo's scheduled passenger flights in mid-2026, and no ICE flight by them after January was found (searched 2026-10-29). Cleared as no longer involved, not as never involved.
